description: §7.3.3 — a nested `function step` in the same block as `let step` binds one name twice in that block: E-SCOPE-REDECLARE.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S439 #6 (the four defer SPEC calls, all recs)
rationale: §7.3.3: 'Inside a function body, a `let`, `const`, `lin` or `function` declaration SHALL NOT redeclare a name already bound in the SAME block — another `let` / `const` / `lin` / `function` declaration of that block'.
